description_en: After you submit a task for a Python 3 script, use the returned requestUuid to retrieve the operational logs
description_zh: 在提交pyhton脚本的任务后，通过返回的requestUuid来获取运行日志
name: DescriberPython3ScriptLogs

parameters.help_en:
The UUID that is returned when you run a Python 3 script.

Call the [RunPython3Script](~~RunPython3Script~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
运行python3脚本时，返回的UUID。
调用[RunPython3Script](~~RunPython3Script~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: request_uuid

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response.

zh (default): Chinese

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。
zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. This ID is generated by Alibaba Cloud and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
